# Events

Mataram pake EventEmitter untuk semua event. Semua event terdefinisi di tipe `MataramEventMap`.

## Daftar Event

| Event | Deskripsi |
|---|---|
| `connection.update` | Status koneksi berubah |
| `creds.update` | Credentials di-update |
| `messages.upsert` | Ada pesan baru |
| `messages.update` | Pesan di-update (edit, react) |
| `messages.delete` | Pesan dihapus |
| `messages.reaction` | Reaction pada pesan |
| `message-receipt.update` | Status pesan terkirim/dibaca |
| `chats.upsert` | Chat baru |
| `chats.update` | Chat di-update |
| `chats.delete` | Chat dihapus |
| `contacts.upsert` | Kontak baru |
| `contacts.update` | Kontak di-update |
| `presence.update` | Status online/typing |
| `groups.upsert` | Grup baru |
| `groups.update` | Grup di-update (nama, foto, dll) |
| `group-participants.update` | Anggota grup berubah |

## connection.update

Event paling penting  ngasih tau status koneksi bot.

```ts
sock.ev.on('connection.update', ({ connection, lastDisconnect, qr }) => {
  switch (connection) {
    case 'connecting':
      console.log('Menghubungkan...')
      break

    case 'open':
      console.log('Terhubung! ID:', sock.user?.id)
      break

    case 'close':
      const code = lastDisconnect?.error?.output?.statusCode
      if (code === DisconnectReason.loggedOut) {
        console.log('Session expired, pairing ulang')
      } else if (code === DisconnectReason.restartRequired) {
        console.log('Restart normal, reconnect...')
      } else {
        console.log('Koneksi putus, reconnect...')
      }
      // Reconnect otomatis
      setTimeout(() => start(), 3000)
      break
  }
})
```

## messages.upsert

Ada pesan baru masuk (atau pesan dari history sync).

```ts
sock.ev.on('messages.upsert', ({ messages, type }) => {
  for (const msg of messages) {
    // type: 'notify' = pesan real-time, 'append' = history sync
    if (type !== 'notify') continue
    if (msg.key.fromMe) continue

    const text = msg.message?.conversation
        || msg.message?.extendedTextMessage?.text
        || '(non-text message)'

    console.log(`[${msg.key.remoteJid}] ${text}`)
  }
})
```

## messages.update

Pesan diedit, di-react, atau statusnya berubah.

```ts
sock.ev.on('messages.update', (updates) => {
  for (const { key, update } of updates) {
    if (update.pollUpdates) {
      // Ada vote poll baru
      console.log('Poll vote:', key.id)
    }
  }
})
```

## messages.reaction

Ada reaction di pesan.

```ts
sock.ev.on('messages.reaction', ({ key, reaction }) => {
  console.log(`React ${reaction.text} oleh ${key.participant}`)
})
```

## presence.update

Seseorang sedang typing / online.

```ts
sock.ev.on('presence.update', ({ id, presences }) => {
  for (const [jid, presence] of Object.entries(presences)) {
    console.log(`${jid}: ${presence.lastKnownPresence}`)
    // 'available' | 'unavailable' | 'composing' | 'recording' | 'paused'
  }
})
```

## group-participants.update

Anggota grup berubah (ada yg join/keluar/ditambah/dihapus).

```ts
sock.ev.on('group-participants.update', ({ id, participants, action }) => {
  console.log(`Grup ${id}: ${action}`, participants)
  // action: 'add' | 'remove' | 'promote' | 'demote'
})
```

## Auto Reconnect Pattern

```ts
async function start() {
  const { state, saveCreds } = await useMultiFileAuthState('auth_info')

  const sock = makeWASocket({ auth: state, browser: Browsers.macOS('Chrome') })
  sock.ev.on('creds.update', saveCreds)

  sock.ev.on('connection.update', ({ connection, lastDisconnect }) => {
    if (connection === 'close') {
      const shouldReconnect = lastDisconnect?.error?.output?.statusCode
        !== DisconnectReason.loggedOut

      if (shouldReconnect) {
        setTimeout(start, 3000) // reconnect setelah 3 detik
      }
    }
  })

  sock.ev.on('messages.upsert', ({ messages }) => {
    // handle messages
  })
}
```
